data.one_liner: A customizable bottom navigation bar matching Aurélien Salomon's design specification.
data.what_it_does: Provides a bottom navigation bar widget that mimics the semantics of Flutter's BottomNavigationBar while adhering to Google's Bottom Bar Navigation Pattern by Aurélien Salomon. Supports item shapes, animations, text directionality, and accessibility.
use_when: You want to implement Aurélien Salomon's Google Bottom Bar Navigation Pattern.
You need a bottom navigation bar with customized item shapes and color transitions.
avoid_when: You require features not covered by Salomon's bottom navigation bar specification.
You are using a navigation pattern other than bottom navigation.
strengths: Meets specifications provided by Aurélien Salomon
Supports accessibility and matches BottomNavigationBar semantics
Customizable colors, shapes, duration, and curve
weaknesses: Any use cases not covered by Salomon's specification are not guaranteed
data.minimal_example:
SalomonBottomBar(
  currentIndex: _currentIndex,
  onTap: (i) => setState(() => _currentIndex = i),
  items: [
    SalomonBottomBarItem(
      icon: Icon(Icons.home),
      title: Text("Home"),
      selectedColor: Colors.purple,
    ),
  ],
)
